insight.notice: No language model was used. The narrative of this page was assembled by the deterministic engine from its own findings.
insight.performance_overview: Over the 60 days from 2026-05-01 to 2026-06-29 the plant delivered 76.07 GWh against an expected 78.49 GWh: a gap of 2.42 GWh (3.1 %). In the assessment window (2026-06-23 to 2026-06-29) the gap is 6.5 %; combined standard uncertainty 2.05 % (k = 2 -> 4.11 %); materiality threshold 3 %. Both energies were available for 78.3 % of the daylight intervals.
uncertainty: Only 78.3 % of daylight intervals have both expected and actual data (minimum for a reliable gap: 90 %). Missing intervals were excluded, not treated as zero production.
Shading: the engine could not evaluate it for want of evidence.
Curtailment or outage: the engine could not evaluate it for want of evidence.
The energy value is a user assumption, not an official or contractual reference.
No recoverable energy is established, so benefit, net benefit and ROI cannot be stated. The break-even energy shows what a cleaning would have to recover.
what_would_change: Reliable measured production data with sufficient completeness, and a baseline of documented origin.
